title: The BRUTAL math:
big: your salary vs. your home loan

title: Home loan in Germany today:
body: Fixed for 10 years. Best offers: around 4.1%.
Rule of thumb: keep your monthly EMI at about 35% of your net salary.
foot: Rates: Dr. Klein best rate 4.11% eff. (23.11.2026), Baufi24 average October 2026: 4.48%.

title: Find your salary
foot: Example: 4.5% interest + 2% repayment a year, 10 years fixed. Not a bank decision, not a guarantee.

title: Plus: the buying costs
body: Most banks want these from your savings – not from the loan.

title: What German banks check for expats
body: - Residence permit (e.g. Blue Card) and how long it is valid
- EMIs in India count too – they lower your budget

title: Why a broker helps
body: Not every bank lends to expats – and offers differ a lot.
A licensed broker compares many banks for you and knows which ones accept your permit.
